title: AHG Agent Heartbeat
description: Compressed per-agent signal payload emitted each governance turn to the AHG Sidecar Monitor. P-42 · AHG_ARCHITECTURE.md §4 · v1.3 · S072 · 2026-07-02

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for the emitting agent (e.g. 'Amethyst', 'COLLEEN', 'Apogee').

turn_id.description: Governance turn number. Monotonically increasing within a session.

D_e_signal.description: Destabilizing Entropy contribution: hallucinations, loops, contradictions. Only this subtype enters S(t).

D_explore_signal.description: Exploratory Divergence contribution: parallel hypothesis generation. Feeds Novelty. Excluded from S(t).

D_correct_signal.description: Corrective Dissent contribution: flaw identification in prior agent output. Feeds Apogee Auditor. Excluded from S(t).

novelty_signal.description: Novelty: proportion of turn content not present in prior turns.

constraint_count.description: Number of active blocking constraints this turn.

revision_count.description: Number of self-corrections or retractions this turn.

coherence_signal.description: Semantic similarity of this agent's output to other agents this turn (K component).
